say:7:1320620006:0.source_cn: 之前那本《魔法师与冒险家》，也是他为你写的书吗？

say:8:1320620007:0.text: Yes... As a child, I was terrified of the dark and often cried, so my brother would write fairy tales to soothe me. In his tales, he was a powerful mage, and I was a little adventurer. He could do anything and always kept me safe.

say:11:1320620010:1.source_cn: 每次通信，哥哥信里都会附上他新读的书单。最后的那几封信...

say:14:1320620013:1.text: My memory of that time is hazy. Hypofiends broke into the temple, and I was injured... Amid the fires and screams, my brother came and took me away to the secret passage my family built.

say:15:1320620014:1.text: He said he would protect me like the great mage in the book and told me not to look back and to run all the way back to the manor. He promised our butler would take me to a safe haven.
say:15:1320620014:1.source_cn: 他说他会像书中的大魔法师一样保护我，让我不要回头，沿着...

say:16:1320620015:1.text: But suddenly, my surroundings turned cold, and thick darkness engulfed me...
say:16:1320620015:1.source_cn: 但是，周围突然变冷了，浓重的黑暗淹没了我……

say:17:1320620016:1.text: Was that the last thing you remember?
say:17:1320620016:1.source_cn: 那是你记忆中最后的画面吗？

say:18:1320620017:1.text: No, I remember waking up for a moment. There was a huge explosion and sounds of flesh being crushed... Also, a piercing pain...
say:18:1320620017:1.source_cn: 不，我清醒了一瞬，巨大的爆炸声……肉被碾碎的声音……刺...

say:19:1320620018:1.text: At the end... I saw my brother before me.
say:19:1320620018:1.source_cn: 最后，我——我看到了，哥哥站在我面前。

say:21:1320620020:1.text: No matter how cold he felt or how he looked, I knew that was my brother Callan.
say:21:1320620020:1.source_cn: 就在那个时刻，我知道，不管变成了什么模样，摸起来有多冰...

say:22:1320620021:1.text: Close your eyes and picture Callan as he was in life. That's the real him.
say:22:1320620021:1.source_cn: 闭上眼睛吧，回想起铐兰生前的样子。那才是他真实的模样。

say:24:1320620023:1.text: For two millennia, the memories of my parents and relatives have been the anchor for my sanity.
say:24:1320620023:1.source_cn: 千百年来，对父母和亲友的回忆维系着我的理性。

say:25:1320620024:1.text: You must learn to remember. Only in this way can you sustain yourself. The people you miss will forever live in your grandest memories, bathed in the perfect light.
say:25:1320620024:1.source_cn: 你一定要学会回忆，只有如此才能维持自我。而你思念的人将...

say:27:1320620026:1.text: Even if I have to be alone again, I wish for Callan's soul to rest in peace.
say:27:1320620026:1.source_cn: 即便重归孤独，我也要让哥哥的灵魂回归安宁。

say:28:1320620027:1.text: Please help me bring him back and free his soul.
